name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph_v2
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring synchronous land-labor scaling, hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding through Day 24, atomic in-situ harvest-and-water servicing, strict Town Shop duration feasibility, and a rigid 0.82x liquidation price floor.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the bankruptcy cascade, purging phantom wheat reserves.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Enforces strict crop-growth duration feasibility gating to ban stranded slow crops, fulfilling demands primarily via existing Strawberry stock or rapid 3-day Carrots.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices, desensitized to trigger only on high risk (>= 0.55).

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing continuous small batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus inventory at favorable market prices (>= 0.88x), unlocking fluid cash for reinvestment while enforcing a strict 0.82x price floor.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into workforce scaling (up to 10-11 hands), synchronous contiguous land expansion (18-20 plots max by Day 15), and hyper-fertilized recurring cash crops (Strawberries) for maximum multi-harvest yield compounding through Day 24.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with in-situ harvest-and-water servicing to eliminate growth stalls. Restricts shed transit to saturated inventory capacity, maximizing plot productivity.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 and active_shop_demand > 0)) and day <= 28
attributes.guidance: Fulfill shop contracts primarily via existing Strawberry stock or rapid 3-day Carrots. Buy shop seeds only if contract_remaining_steps >= (crop_growth_steps + safety_buffer) AND current_day + crop_growth_days <= 28. Prohibit planting unfertilized Pumpkins or single-harvest shop crops unless contract premiums exceed 3.0x base price.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not plant slow single-harvest crops that cannot mature before contract expiry. Instantly release uncontracted surplus to open-market liquidation.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (>= 0.82 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed markets. Maintain absolute price floor of 0.82x base price. Do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.guidance: Execute frequent small batch sales (8-10 units) of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings when market price >= 0.88 * base_price. Maintain absolute liquidation price floor at >= 0.82 * base_price even if shed overflow is imminent.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell below 0.82x base price. Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3).

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 2.0 + 100.0 and (hired_hands < 11 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 25
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce to 10-11 hands. Synchronously scale contiguous land to 16 plots by Day 10 (hands >= 6) and 18-20 plots by Day 15 (hands >= 9), gated strictly by cash > 2.0x payroll + plot/input costs. Maintain hyper-fertilized Strawberries as the exclusive compounding engine through Day 24-25. Restrict fast-crop Carrots strictly to Day 25+ on newly cleared or vacant plots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land after Day 16. Never dig up or overwrite an active perennial Strawberry plot. Do not plant Carrots before Day 25 unless bootstrapping. Ensure persistent fertilizer procurement for all Strawberry plots.

attributes.guidance: Execute in-situ harvest-and-water servicing: any worker positioned on a mature perennial plot must execute an immediate atomic sequence (Harvest plot, then immediately Water plot before moving). Restrict shed transit strictly to when inventory capacity is saturated or at step 714 for final end-of-game cash conversion. Priority sequence: 1) Atomic Harvest-and-Water, 2) Water dry crops, 3) Plant seeds, 4) Drop off at shed (only if full), 5) Feed livestock.
attributes.pitfalls: Never allow a harvested Strawberry plot to remain dry while workers traverse the field or shed. Do not transit to shed unless inventory is full or at step 714. Ensure hands never idle.
